# Supported agents

Every agent in the catalogue, the ports each version has proven, and the benchmarks it fits.

<!-- generated by app/tests/catalogue_docs.py from app/nullius/catalogue: do not edit by hand -->

### Available agents

| Agent | Versions (bare key: the default) | What it is | Driven over | From | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Codex](codex.md) | `codex@2.2.2`, `codex@0.16.0` | OpenAI's coding agent. | ACP via `codex-acp` | npm | Apache-2.0 |
| [Goose](goose.md) | `goose` | The AAIF's open-source agent, formerly Block's. | ACP | npm | Apache-2.0 |
| [JiuwenSwarm](jiuwenswarm.md) | `jiuwenswarm@0.2.7`, `jiuwenswarm@0.2.8` | openJiuwen's agent. | ACP | PyPI | Apache-2.0 |
| [mini-swe-agent](mini-swe-agent.md) | `mini-swe-agent` | Princeton's 100-line agent, bash only. | a command | PyPI | MIT |
| [OpenCode](opencode.md) | `opencode` | The open-source terminal coding agent. | ACP | npm | MIT |
| [Terminus 2](terminus-2.md) | `terminus-2` | Harbor's terminal agent, used by Terminal-Bench. | a command | PyPI | Apache-2.0 |

- ACP (`start.acp`) can prove task, workspace, tools, conversation and search; a command (`start.command` with `{prompt}`) task, workspace and search only.
- Examples, never offered for a run: `reference` (Example agent: Nullius's example of the protocol, to read or copy.)

### Ports proven

| Port | Label | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| `agent.task/v1` | One task | One prompt in, one turn; the answer is the agent's final message. |
| `agent.workspace/v1` | Workspace files | The session's working directory is the unit's workspace; the agent reads and writes files there. |
| `agent.tools/v1` | MCP tools | The agent calls the tools of the MCP servers given to its session. |
| `agent.conversation/v1` | Conversation | Several prompts in one session, each answered in its own turn, the earlier ones remembered. |
| `agent.search/v1` | Search | Search an HTTP collection, retrieve a source and answer with its evidence using the agent's available tools. |
| `agent.browser/v1` | Browser | A browser reached through an MCP server Nullius starts. |

### Harbor agents

Every agent `harbor agents list` finds in the pinned Harbor, as *Harbor built-in*, and the builder's own:

| Agent | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `tau3-llm-agent` | reference | τ³'s own reference agent, from Harbor's source tree. |
| `oracle` | control | Applies the task's reference solution; never calls a model. A ceiling, never ranked. |
| `nop` | control | Does nothing. The floor a verifier must reject. |
